title: Strategy beacon and commitment lattice for monthly roadmap review
creator: Aisha Malik
description: Objective: Create a concise, repeatable artifact (the 'strategy beacon' + 'commitment lattice') that the PMs, Eng leads, Design, and Finance can use to run the monthly roadmap review with execs and make final commitment decisions. Scope: a 2-page one-pager for execs, a single-slide commitment lattice visualization, a canonical Confluence template, a short runbook for decision rules and escalation lanes, and a sample ask spreadsheet with staged funding lanes. Deliverables: (1) Confluence template 'Strategy Beacon', (2) Drive folder with 1-pager + slide, (3) Commitment lattice SVG and source figma frames, (4) short runbook (steps, owners, SLO/risk columns), (5) example board-ready slide populated with runtime cost and latency risk metrics. Out of scope: replacing quarterly QBR playbooks or Board packets—this is for the recurring monthly cadence used by product & eng leadership to adjust near-term commitments.
acceptance_criteria: Confluence template created and linked to product playbooks
Design-approved commitment lattice visual and figma frames
1-pager that fits on two pages and highlights three decision asks
Finance has validated cost ask ranges and staged lanes
Engineering has validated estimated delivery windows and risk bands
Runbook contains clear escalation paths and fallback policies
